snippet.title: Shuwa Shuwa Guin! - Announcement trailer (EN)
snippet.description:
Shuwa Shuwa Guin is a time management game set in a charming world of penguins, where you must wash, dry, and iron clothes to keep your grandfather's laundry business open! Use the money you earn to buy items that will make your job easier!

Wishlist now on Steam! 🐧✨
linktr.ee/wattoprod
